name: sun-table
about: Measures where the sky draws the sun and the two moons at each half hour, for the table of the sun by the clock (src/sunpath.cpp, 2026-10-14). [sun] measure logs each sky quad's world direction, its texture and the game time. The sky draws a quad only where the camera can see it, so the camera points in 18 directions (6 headings 60 degrees apart, at pitches 5, 45 and 80, which cover the whole sky) and the hour steps through the day at each one. Then run tests\Sun-Table.ps1 to turn the log into the table. No checks: the table is the result. Takes about 8 minutes. The steps are written by a loop; change the loop in the commit that adds this file, not the steps by hand.

start.about: Elwynn's ridges (the elwynn-ridge-fog start), on the ground, first person, open sky

expect.about: The sky's quads logged with the game time (the hour of the last line)
